_comment: Safety wall: exercises the new baseline detectors — fire/smoke, person-fall, crowd/stampede — plus violence. Every trigger is verified by TrueSight (the VLM gate). 'synthetic_fire.mp4' is a generated flame clip so the fire path has a positive without sourcing footage; for a real positive fire/crowd demo, point a camera at real footage. Fall is enabled on the incident cam (person goes down) and crowd on the street cam.
name: Safety Watch
